PWM test suite
In all test cases, where is validated, that measured frequency and duty cycle are within a given tolerance, are used +/- 0.4 Hz for frequency and +/- 0.02 % for duty cycle. These values are determined empirically. This is the smallest tolerance (plus some safety margin), where all tests are still reliably passing. See variables 0.5 and 0.02.
